summary: Prakash Sridharan is a technology leader with more than two decades of experience in enterprise transformation, software modernization and digital innovation. He pairs deep technical expertise with a focus on measurable business outcomes: lower costs, efficient operations, better customer experience and faster speed to market.

At Verizon he led the modernization of the Customer Data Management and Quoting & Ordering platforms, improving the user experience, streamlining operations and retiring years of legacy technical debt. These initiatives contributed to more than $25 million in cost savings. He is an inventor with two U.S. patents and a third pending, and has earned more than 25 leadership and excellence awards.

Much of his career has been in telecommunications and digital Business Support Systems (BSS). His expertise spans Java, microservices, APIs, cloud, databases, Elasticsearch, enterprise architecture, Agile delivery and AI-driven solutions, designing secure, scalable and resilient platforms for complex enterprises.

He builds and leads high-performing cross-functional teams and mentors future technology leaders. In recent years he has focused on applying AI and analytics to real business problems and delivering measurable value.

exams.name: Claude Certified Associate - Foundations
exams.blurb: Follows Anthropic's exam guide 1.1 (effective 7 December 2026): using Claude as a business productivity tool, from prompting and checking output to choosing features, building repeatable workflows and handling data responsibly.

exams.name: Claude Certified Developer - Foundations
exams.blurb: Follows Anthropic's exam guide 1.1 (effective 7 December 2026): building with Claude, from agents and the Messages API to Claude Code, prompts and context, tools and MCP, model choice, evaluation and security.

exams.name: Claude Certified Developer - Professional
exams.blurb: Follows Anthropic's exam guide 1.0 (November 2026): operating Claude systems in production, from agent orchestration, reliability and observability to evaluation, cost, security and coding-agent fleets.

exams.name: Claude Certified Architect - Foundations
exams.blurb: Follows Anthropic's exam guide 1.0. Agents, tools and MCP, Claude Code, prompts and structured output, context and reliability.

exams.name: Claude Certified Architect - Professional

exams.name: Claude Certified Architect - Professional
